messages:
Sasha: quick design q — for client-side A/B hooks, should we rely on an opt-in request header or keep bucketing server-side? proposing header: x-redwood-variant: canary-v2 (opt-in). thoughts?
Ben: +1 to opt-in header. SDK can opt users in via a flag. simpler for client experiments. :thumbsup:
Alejandro: also +1 but prefer shorter name x-rw-variant for header size. SDK option: enableClientRouting: true. need server validation though.
Priya: big concern is telemetry fragmentation. if clients choose variants we still need unified metrics. server should validate client-sent variants and emit a metric label like client_routed=true so console can surface it.
deploy-bot: canary-deploy: started canary-v2 -> 10% traffic us-east (automated)
Sasha: agreed on server-side guard. proposed flow: SDK sets header only when enableClientRouting true. server checks account-level allowlist + quota, then stamps trace and emits client_routed. fallback to server-bucket when invalid. example server pseudocode:```
if header.x-rw-variant and account.allows_client_routing:
  if account.client_routing_quota > 0:
    apply_variant(header.x-rw-variant)
    record(metric: "variant.applied", labels: {variant: header.x-rw-variant, client_routed: true})
  else:
    fallthrough_to_server_bucket()
else:
  fallthrough_to_server_bucket()
```
Ben: also suggest SDK include a trace id header so we can join client vs platform traces: x-rw-trace: t_12345. and maybe x-rw-variant-ttl to avoid long-lived stuck routing.
Alejandro: TTL is good. propose x-rw-variant-ttl: 300 (seconds). proxies/CDNs can respect it. also let's avoid exposing experiment ids — use opaque variant names.
Priya: Console UX note: we need per-variant breakdown with a dimension for routing_source: client | platform. otherwise rollout metrics will be misleading during canaries. add a regression alert on mismatch between client opt-in pct and server-observed pct.
Sasha: will draft an RFC + PR: SDK flag, header names, server guard, telemetry labels, and console dimension. will add unit tests for invalid header, quota exhaustion, and trace linking. ETA: EOD for RFC, follow-up PR next week.
